result.topic_en: Calculations on theta characteristics: counting even and odd characteristics mod 2 (numbers 2^{p-1}(2^p±1)) via a recursion, a 4×4 characteristic table, products of square roots of quadratic expressions, and the form of abelian integrals of the first kind with a Riemann-surface sketch.
